newsitem.title: GREECE: PRESS DIGEST - GREEK GENERAL NEWS - MARCH 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - GREEK GENERAL NEWS - MARCH 3.

text.p: Leading stories in the Greek general press:
--Hunger, fury and chaos: Albania in a death's grip with the prospect of civil war as insurgents roam the streets with weapons and President Sali Berisha blames communists and foreign insurgents.
--Prime Minister Costas Simitis lashes out against the Communist Party of Greece (KKE), saying they want the "Albanisation" of the country.

--The finance ministry's new E9 real estate declaration form will be used to cross-check rentals earnings, residency and any other incidents leading to the evasion of taxation, Deputy Finance Minister George Drys says.
--The Greek authorities have increased border patrols to avert any increase in the smuggling of illegal immigrants or weapons from Albania.

--The winners and losers at conservative opposition New Democracy's pre-congress convention in Thessaloniki over the weekend. A recent opinion poll shows support for a younger leadership of the party.
--Athens fears the Albanian insurgency turning on the Greek minority and the unrest expanding to the mainly-ethnic Albanian populated region of Kosovo, in Yugoslavia.
